thread:
lina: heads up: customer A saw a 502 when they actually exceeded a tenant quota on a dedicated route. they expected 429.
omar: can you paste the response/headers?
lina: ```http
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: application/json
X-Route: ded-emb-9
X-Quota: evaluated_late
X-Trace: t-9987
{ "error": "upstream_unavailable" }
```
jeff: another late-enforcement case. gateway forwarded, route did a quota check and returned a proxy 502. so client sees 502 not 429. bad UX for integrators.
maya: we need a small, machine-friendly contract so integrators can tell the difference. proposal: add `X-Outcome` header with values: `quota_exceeded`, `infra_failure`, `unknown`. gateway rewrites outward status when possible: `quota_exceeded` -> 429, else leave 5xx. also emit `X-Outcome-Code` numeric for programmatic handling (eg 429.10 tenant_quota, 429.11 route_quota, 500.30 shard_down).
omar: agree but careful with streaming: can't change initial HTTP status mid-stream. plan for streaming: append a final control message JSON chunk like `\{"control":"end","outcome":"quota_exceeded","outcome_code":"429.10"\}` then close. doc the SDK behavior.
jeff: telemetry: add `response_outcome_total{outcome="quota_exceeded|infra_failure|unknown", route="...", outcome_code="..."}` and a derived panel `misattributed_5xx = sum(response_outcome_total{outcome="quota_exceeded", http_code=~"5.."}) / sum(response_total{http_code=~"5.."})`. this will show how often infra codes mask quota.
lina: console: new "Error Etiology" card on route details that shows pie: quota vs infra vs unknown, plus a CTA to request quota increase when quota fraction > 1%. copy: "This route is experiencing quota rejections. Request limits or contact support." keep terse.
maya: rollout: feature-flag `error_etiology_normalization` at gateway and route-proxy. canary 7% for 24h. monitors: expected 429 increase, no rise in true infra 5xx, client SDKs not breaking on stream termination messages. add alert if stream-terminal events > 0.7% traffic.
omar: testing: add an integration scenario that simulates late quota enforcement returning a proxy 502 then asserts gateway emits 429 with `X-Outcome` + `X-Outcome-Code`. add stream test for final control chunk.
jeff: ops note: ensure logs include both `outcome` and `internal_error` fields in structured logs. makes debugging easier.
lina: ownership: @jeff will add metrics + dashboard tile, @omar will implement propagation header and gateway rewrite, @maya will update SDK docs and streaming guides, I'll draft customer follow-up and console copy.
ops-bot: deploy started: feat/error-etiology -> gateway-canary (7%)
lina: i'll monitor canary for 12h and post results. keep PR feedback focused on header names and numeric code registry.
maya: one last note: add changelog entry and a short migration guide for integrators to prefer `X-Outcome-Code` over http status when present.
